text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Looks like you got plenty of rest!
Looks like you got a good rest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I casually dropped by a park yesterday, 
and there was nobody around at all. Whew, 
had myself a great nap.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Even if your suffocatingly intense face is 
the first thing I see in the morning, 
well, I'll let it slide today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seems to be feeling much 
better!
